title: POV: they ask if you can cover tomorrow and you say yes before doing the math
description:
picking up a shift feels like easy money. then the check lands and it's less than you thought.

overtime, night pay, tax, deductions... the math is real and nobody shows it to you.

we built ShiftPayday's calculator for this. put in your rate and your week and it shows your take-home with the full breakdown, before you say yes to the extra shift.

the calculator is free, no account needed. it's an estimate from the rates you enter, not tax advice.

#shiftwork #overtime #paycheck #hourlyworker #nightshift
